instruction:
Use the ANSYS Fluent GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: 3D laminar flow in a circular pipe.

Model parameters:
- Straight pipe: diameter 4 mm, length 100 mm
- Fluid: water
- Mesh: structured hexahedral or swept mesh, 3 boundary-layer layers

Boundary conditions:
- Inlet: velocity inlet, mean velocity 0.1 m/s
- Outlet: pressure outlet, gauge pressure 0 Pa
- Pipe wall: stationary, no-slip

Analysis type: laminar steady-state analysis

Solver setup:
- Pressure-based solver, steady
- Laminar model
- Second-order schemes

Save requirements:
- Case and Data files: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\pipe_laminar.cas and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\pipe_laminar.dat
